title: Ginger Yogurt Chicken Curry
summary: Chicken thighs marinated in yogurt and spices, then simmered in a mild onion and tomato sauce. Gentle enough for kids, rich enough for guests.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Weeknight Indian curries built from a well-stocked spice drawer.

ingredients.name: chicken thigh
ingredients.preparation: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

ingredients.name: plain yogurt
ingredients.notes: whole-milk yogurt is less likely to split

steps.instruction: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and mix in a bowl with the yogurt, ginger, garlic, cumin, garam masala and salt. Marinate at least 15 minutes in the fridge.
success_cues: Every piece is coated in the marinade
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.
Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.
steps.creator_note: Overnight marinating is even better if you plan ahead.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
success_cues: Onions are soft and golden brown
warnings: Hot oil can spit; add food away from your body and keep the handle turned inward.

steps.instruction: Add the crushed tomatoes and cook until thick and the oil starts to separate, about 5 minutes.
success_cues: Sauce is thick and glossy with oil around the edges
warnings: Thick tomato sauce spatters; stir with a long spoon.

steps.instruction: Add the chicken with all its marinade and stir. Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
success_cues: Sauce is smooth and creamy, not grainy
A thermometer in the largest piece reads 165°F (74°C)
warnings: Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.
steps.creator_note: Keep the heat low once the yogurt goes in or it can curdle.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt, add a splash of water if too thick and serve with rice.
success_cues: Sauce clings to the chicken and tastes balanced

creator_notes: Use a separate board for the raw chicken.
